visual_review.notes: H3 video, first takes. The move and attack plates failed the matte at their computed edge thresholds (192 and 170, raised by the gold body in their references); at 160, like the other takes, they matte cleanly. The idle curls the forearm blade back and melts it four times; frames 20 and 80 match, so the loop runs the calm stretches 20-42 and 80-103 forward and back. A single-reference idle retake turned the body to profile and flapped the fans, too busy for an idle. The lens fires a flash at 55 although nothing should fire; the attack runs to the full-reach thrust at 53 and resumes at 85 as the arm retracts. The death skips two green-fringed collapse frames. Re-matted 2026-10-14 with the green-plate spill limit: the green rims on thin and blurred edges are gone, with the same frames, timing, anchor and scale.
